Yes. Hansen recorded approximately **81.3 hectares of tree-cover loss** within the property in 2021, equivalent to **2.23%** of its area. A further 37.3 hectares occurred in patches smaller than 0.5 hectares and were not counted as events.

Most of the 81.3 hectares was mapped as planted forest. Tree-cover loss does not by itself establish deforestation, its cause, or whether it was legal.
